summary.reconciliationNotice: Reconciled component suite totals after inspecting underlying test outputs. Distinguishes historical in-engine Unity Editor test runs from current CI static-checks and Node/Windows regression suites.

repositoryAndLauncherSuites.name: Production Readiness Verification
repositoryAndLauncherSuites.notes: 6 production checks passed: zero browser remnants, server room cap (5 players max), security endpoints, and assembly definitions.

repositoryAndLauncherSuites.name: Production Asset Verification
repositoryAndLauncherSuites.notes: 41 asset assertions: 36 production manifest entries verified, player hero GLB integrity (13 meshes, 7 materials, 24 animations), license metadata.

repositoryAndLauncherSuites.name: Server Process Cleanup & Port Release Regression
repositoryAndLauncherSuites.notes: 2 checks passed: process tree clean termination and port re-binding verification without socket leaks.

repositoryAndLauncherSuites.name: Candidate Windows Launcher Provenance & Safety Suite
repositoryAndLauncherSuites.notes: 85 regression checks passed on Windows: archive SHA-256 verification, provenance markers, path traversal guards, duplicate process locking, binary tampering rejection, and v1.0.0 immutability protection.
